arxiv-2308-16351.title: Time Calibration of the Baikal-GVD Neutrino Telescope with Atmospheric Muons
arxiv-2308-16351.creator: D.Y. Zvezdov
arxiv-2308-16351.description: Abstract [b,g]D. Seitova † † footnotetext: Deceased. Abstract. We present a new procedure for time calibration of the Baikal-GVD neutrino telescope. The track reconstruction quality depends on accurate measurements of arrival times of Cherenkov photons. Therefore, it is crucial to achieve a high precision in time calibration.

arxiv-2411-16901.title: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks Structured Pruning via Gravity Regularization
arxiv-2411-16901.creator: Abdesselam Ferdi
arxiv-2411-16901.description: Abstract Structured pruning is a widely employed strategy for accelerating deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs). However, existing methods often necessitate modifications to the original architectures, involve complex implementations, and require lengthy fine-tuning stages. To address these challenges, we propose a novel physics-inspired approach that integrates the concept of gravity into the training stage of DCNNs.

arxiv-2505-24308.description: Abstract This study presents the black hole accretion history (BHAH) of obscured active galactic nuclei (AGNs) identified from the JWST CEERS survey by Chien et al. (2024) using mid-infrared (MIR) SED fitting. We compute black hole accretion rates (BHARs) to estimate the black hole accretion density (BHAD), ρ L disk \rho_{L_{\text{disk}}} , across 0 < z < 4.25 0<z<4.25 .

arxiv-2602-07992.description: Abstract The emergence of compositional reasoning in large language models through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been a key driver of recent empirical successes. pmc-11427906.title: Pseudo-hyperacute T-waves in a giant thoracic aortic aneurysm
pmc-11427906.creator: Masahiro Ishikura, Yoshiaki Kawase, Hirooki Higami, Hitoshi Matsuo, Amir Khalifa, Dzan Horozic, Bruno Rocha
pmc-11427906.description: A computed tomography (CT) scan also showed the TAA, which was 11 cm in a diameter, with no evidence of rupture. After urgent thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), the patient’s subjective symptoms improved and the ECG changes present on admission also improved. The present case illustrates that compression of the heart by a giant TAA induces hyperacute T-waves mimicking ACS.

pmc-12608474.description: Background/Objectives: It would be desirable to reduce the intake of inorganic phosphate (P), which is easily absorbed and is associated with cardiovascular disease. pmc-12692543.title: Development of Norrin-Based Protein Therapeutic for Activation of Norrin-Wnt Signaling in Human Retinal Endothelial Cells
pmc-12692543.creator: Kenneth P. Mitton, Wendy A. Dailey, Steven Q. Krikor, Kimberly A. Drenser
pmc-12692543.description: Norrin–Wnt signaling is essential for retinal vascular development and generation of the inner blood retinal barrier. Norrin itself is a potential therapeutic for retinal vascular repair. We explored the feasibility of producing a recombinant protein therapeutic based on human Norrin for intravitreal injection. NorrinK86P production was tested using MBP fusion and non-tagged versions.

pmc-13104144.description: Understanding the mechanisms that enable invasive species to expand into novel thermal environments is key to predict their future distribution range under climate change. pmc-13398334.title: Influenza Virus Isolation for Public Health Surveillance Before, During, and After the COVID-19 Pandemic: Experiences from the New York State National Influenza Reference Center Laboratory
pmc-13398334.creator: Amruta Pramod Moghe, Emaly Starrett Leak, Jennifer May Laplante, Kirsten St. George
pmc-13398334.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Influenza viruses can cause mild to severe illnesses. The burden of disease varies widely depending on multiple factors, including the type and subtype of circulating viruses, timing of the season, flu vaccine efficacy and vaccination rates. Influenza viruses are also highly prone to genetic change and rapid spread due to modern human movement patterns, making influenza surveillance vital for public health awareness, guidance, policy, disease mitigation, and annual recommendations on vaccine composition.

pmc-13473628.title: Curcumin-stabilized silver nanoparticles target the Helicobacter pylori-tumor interface in gastric cancer
pmc-13473628.creator: Komal Attri, Deepinder Sharda, Isha Tanwar, Priyanshu Gautam, Diptiman Choudhury
pmc-13473628.description: Gastric cancer remains a major global health burden, ranking among the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Chronic infection with Helicobacter pylori is a well-established etiological factor, promoting sustained gastric inflammation, epithelial transformation, and tumor progression through modulation of the gastric microenvironment. Therapeutic strategies that simultaneously target microbial virulence and tumor cell survival remain limited.
